channel.title: Hunk releases
channel.description: Release notes for Hunk, the review-first terminal diff viewer.

item.title: Hunk 0.21.0-beta.1 (Prerelease)
item.description: Hunk 0.21 turns reviews into a richer agent-aware workspace with authenticated live sessions, editable threaded notes, two-revision and two-file comparisons, more responsive navigation, and a broader extension surface.

item.title: Hunk 0.21.0-beta.0 (Prerelease)
item.description: Hunk 0.21 turns reviews into a richer agent-aware workspace with authenticated live sessions, editable threaded notes, two-revision and two-file comparisons, more responsive navigation, and a broader extension surface.

item.title: Hunk 0.20
item.description: Hunk 0.20 adds a one-line installer with conditional checksum verification and self-updates, launches a directory of 12 community extensions, and makes line-level reviewing faster and more precise.

item.title: Hunk 0.19
item.description: Hunk 0.19.0 expands the extension platform, makes live agent guidance more precise, and keeps large reviews responsive.

item.title: Hunk 0.18
item.description: Hunk 0.18.0 makes reviews more precise, customizable, and extensible—while improving performance and reliability across large repositories and diverse terminals.

item.title: Hunk 0.18.0-beta.0 (Prerelease)
item.description: Hunk 0.18.0 makes reviews more precise, customizable, and extensible—while improving performance and reliability across large repositories and diverse terminals.

item.title: Hunk 0.17
item.description: Hunk 0.17 makes the review chrome configurable, adds an Agent menu for setting up the review skill, and smooths out scrolling, theming, and session reliability across platforms.

item.title: Hunk 0.16
item.description: Hunk 0.16 rebuilds the built-in theme system around a single theme setting with a live selector, and lets custom themes inherit from any built-in theme.

item.title: Hunk 0.15
item.description: Hunk 0.15 adds release benchmark gating, Sapling support, and a run of rendering performance work that keeps large reviews responsive on Windows and Unix alike.

item.title: Hunk 0.14
item.description: Hunk 0.14 adds mouse-drag selection with clipboard copy, inline expansion of collapsed unchanged context, and the Catppuccin Latte and Mocha themes.

item.title: Hunk 0.13
item.description: Hunk 0.13 adds human-authored inline notes saved with c, an e shortcut to open the selected file in $EDITOR, and g/G jump navigation.

item.title: Hunk 0.12
item.description: Hunk 0.12 brings native Windows support, Homebrew release automation, terminal-aware light and dark theme detection, and row windowing for very large single-file reviews.

item.title: Hunk 0.11
item.description: Hunk 0.11 adds Jujutsu support through vcs = "jj", a pager-mode sidebar file tree, and steadier cross-file hunk navigation.

item.title: Hunk 0.10
item.description: Hunk 0.10 introduces hunk daemon serve as the standard session entrypoint, publishes reusable session-broker packages, and surfaces agent comment counts in the sidebar.
